base.common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a premium Clanverse character reaction emoji. One isolated head-and-tiny-shoulders portrait on genuinely transparent alpha background. Art direction: simple polished soft 3D game emoji, rounded sculpted forms, restrained satin highlights, clean readable expression, smooth shading. NOT photorealism, NOT skin pores, NOT gritty detail, NOT flat vector, NOT full-body illustration. Front-facing with extremely slight three-quarter depth, face centered, entire hair and head visible, generous empty padding, compact silhouette readable at 48px. Even warm softbox lighting from upper left, consistent mild glossy finish. No background, scenery, ground, card, frame, typography, text, watermark, weapons, full body or extra characters. Expression: happy grinning face like the standard grinning-face emoji, friendly bright open eyes and a cheerful small open smile showing upper teeth.
specs: Character: the recognizable Archer from Clash of Clans: young adult woman with vivid magenta-pink chin-length bob hair and straight bangs, green hood framing the sides/back of hair, large expressive brown eyes, fair warm skin, small confident brows, minimal green collar at bottom. Make a refined 3D emoji bust, mature game-character proportions, not a child or baby. Hair readable as one clean stylized shape. No bow, arrow, quiver, unrelated headpiece or extra jewellery.

Character: the recognizable Barbarian from Clash of Clans: adult male warrior, short bright blond squared crew-cut hair, strong brown eyebrows, very recognizable thick blond horseshoe moustache, broad nose and jaw, warm peach skin, small visible shoulders and brown leather collar/strap at bottom. Friendly bold expressive game-character proportions, a head emoji rather than muscular full body. No helmet, sword, crown or beard. Keep the blond moustache clearly visible and distinct from the smile.
